title: TRKB el pack
description: Family Pack, for playing vanilla Minecraft more comfortably. Ultra-optimized, without being unnecessarily overloaded. You don't need 100 mods to play at high FPS. Don't get ripped off.
body:
**Family Pack**, for playing vanilla Minecraft more comfortably. Ultra-optimized, without being unnecessarily overloaded. You don't need 100 mods to play at high FPS. Don't get ripped off.

For fun and variety, we've added another type of battle against the **DRAGON** and the **WITHER**. In addition to a fun way to talk through voice chat.

The **TRKB el pack** aims to provide a base of the best optimization mods available, configured for the maximum performance achievable.
